stages.representation: four convergent plain-sparsity sparse FP8 F32 inline-PTX probe modules in D, A, B, C, metadata, selector order
stages.detail: Pinned LLVM lowered a per-intrinsic probe matrix at sm_89/+ptx84. Each module is one convergent inline-asm define; the four sources have SHA-256 0e19213f66bf48490191dcb26cec4fbcc9b3811b9d470d720c7d3ca6dd75fe92, d1488ca123f1d551a8d11054e757bcb996c9b46288387472a5c1deec77ad6d3e, 7fc0a1505fdbff6b417c104d0e86630c5b7646cacc26de1362829305c520f8b7, cc638d7394b354e17d0e2e226ddfd9329b70eba4da6f4e5d757f41b8a1e8ac8d and the four 2,905-byte PTX outputs have SHA-256 422fc5b0a05111aa642045eb5457f4c2015e333680893446e36a1ce5219cce76, 75fcba9ddcd36eadc1f2fda9545b99b722b7176b741415f8e6e8308885f314ab, 277ab86e14079870065530ce63f8ca013ce7010ae586d345de5e1d178c3a8560 and fff31942daac87bc05a1113d194a660980ace3ea0f03b00f89142faad53810ba. Every module retains exactly one unguarded instruction of the requested form with 4+4+4+4 register operands, a metadata register and the selector immediate 0.

stages.representation: exact-floor plain-sparsity sparse FP8 F32 PTX
stages.detail: CUDA 13.3 ptxas accepted all four per-intrinsic probe PTX files at PTX 8.4 and sm_89, and assembled an all-four-forms fixture wrapped in a .visible .entry into a 3,368-byte cubin (SHA-256 6055d90ad156664d015627200c40b8d77cb9853ed3d87dce9fcda2a1461e4e78) whose .text.sparse_fp8_all_probe section is 384 bytes of real SASS. The per-intrinsic probe modules carry no .entry, so ptxas eliminates their bodies and emits a 1,464-byte stub cubin (SHA-256 b1f806ccaa8a73aa80b76862b643265a508494c53028348b0f4e730d7a86847a); the already-admitted dense FP8 MMA family produces the identical 1,464-byte stub, so the stubbing is a property of the single-.func probe harness and not of these forms.
